'''OTSD Booster Draft''' is a booster draft format played with the [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]] (OTSD). [[Decipher]] published it as the "Star Wars CCG Sanctioned OTSD Booster Draft", and the [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015) keeps it under the same name.<ref name="dec-otsdbd">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/otsdboosterdraft-sw.asp Rules - Star Wars CCG Sanctioned OTSD Booster Draft], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020809203309/http://tournaments.decipher.com/otsdboosterdraft-sw.asp Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (by 2002); Players Committee (2015)
* '''Card pool:''' one Official Tournament Sealed Deck per player; the boosters are drafted, the premium cards are not
* '''In use:''' by 2002 &ndash; listed in 2015
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Each player starts with one Official Tournament Sealed Deck.<ref name="dec-otsdbd" /><ref name="afg" /> Decipher's rules:<ref name="dec-otsdbd" />
* Players sit in groups of 6 where possible, otherwise groups of 4. The tournament director may need to draft a dummy hand to keep the numbers of Light and Dark players equal, and always drafts in a group of 6, competitively.
* Players are assigned Light or Dark at random and seated alternately, never next to a player of the same side.
* Each player opens a Premiere booster, takes one card for their own side of the Force only ("There is no defensive drafting"), and passes the rest to the left. Nobody picks up the next stack until everyone has picked. Passing direction switches after each pack. When the Premiere boosters are finished, the A New Hope booster is drafted the same way, in order of release.
* The eighteen premium cards are not drafted; each player keeps their own and may use them.
* Everyone then has 10 minutes to build a 40-card deck. Unused cards may be substituted into the deck between games, keeping it at 40 cards. The tournament is then run under Decipher's regular sealed deck rules.

The Players Committee guide gives the same procedure under its general [[Booster Draft]] rules: the 18-card premium packs are opened as if the format were sealed, and only the booster packs are drafted.<ref name="afg" /> Its group-size table differs from Decipher's for 12 players: Decipher put them in 2 groups of 6, the guide in 3 groups of 4.<ref name="dec-otsdbd" /><ref name="afg" />

== History ==
Decipher's Star Wars tournament resources page of August 2002 listed "OTSD Booster Draft Format" among its format notes, next to [[EPP Overdrive]], Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck, Reflections II booster draft and the two closed environments.<ref name="dec-ressw">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Star Wars tournament resources], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020808154840/http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Internet Archive].</ref> When Decipher first published the OTSD draft rules is unknown. The Players Committee listed the format again in its 2015 guide.<ref name="afg" />
